text:
Jordan: quick thought — run a focused 3hr micro SIG with VoltEdge to validate perf/W gains from their kernel tweak. light deliverable: a marketplace badge + short joint blog excerpt.
Priya: sounds good. VoltEdge gave us Tue morning. need to lock test vector and quant config.
Marc: agree. propose success metrics: tokens/sec @ seq=1024, average watts from PDU, 95th tail latency. also record memory and temp if possible.
Lina: marketplace wants a simple chart: perf/W delta vs baseline and a 40-60 word blurb. I can mock it.
Jordan: kernel patch identifier is `kpatch/v0.9.3-volt-tune`, quant profile `q4_0_mixed` for the tuned run.
Priya: lab checklist: remote KVM, PDU SNMP creds, kernel artifacts, HV sensor access. who owns getting creds from VoltEdge?
Marc: I can pick up PDU creds. VoltEdge contact is @voltops_jake — please loop him in for OIDs.
Jordan: @voltops_jake can you confirm which SNMP OIDs map to per-board watts and whether you can expose per-card readings during our 3hr slot?
voltops_jake: we can expose per-board watts and temps. will DM SNMP OIDs and temp mapping. quick note: VoltEdge legal will require an NDA addendum for publishing numbers.
Lina: legal flagged the addendum. will coordinate language — probably a 1-paragraph addendum and a 7-day review on any public material.
Marc: public naming check: if legal requests, we'll publish as "VoltEdge test rig" plus family name. keep raw CSVs in private repo for partner review.
Jordan: schedule outline: Tue 09:00 PT smoke/env check, 09:15 baseline run, 10:00 deploy kernel patch + warmup, 10:15 tuned run, 11:15 cache-disabled run, 11:45 data collection + teardown.
Priya: artifacts to bring: `run.sh --profile=q4_0_mixed`, `model.pb`, `kpatch_v0.9.3-volt.tar.gz`, runtime image `redwood/infer:bench-2026-03-30`.
Marc: I'll own the bench script and graphs. will push a minimal script to gitlab and a README for reproducibility.
Lina: I'll draft the 250-word marketplace blurb and a mock chart by EOD Mon. question: do we want a joint blog or just a marketplace badge?
Jordan: aim for both if VoltEdge is okay. short joint blog + marketplace badge. legal to approve copy, VoltEdge wants a 7-day review window.
Priya: telemetry plan: collect PDU CSVs, runtime logs, perf traces, and a per-run metadata file. retention: keep raw data private for 30 days then archive to partner bucket. ok?
Jordan: yes. add public note that this is synthetic load (not customer traffic).
Marc: benchmark command draft: `./run.sh --model model.pb --seq 1024 --iters 1000 --profile q4_0_mixed --log csv > out.csv` — I'll run with `--pkv=true` enabled/disabled for two variants.
Priya: add `--pkv=true` for prefix cache toggle, and `--thermals=true` to collect thermal sensors if the runtime supports it.
Jordan: action items: Marc (script + graphs + push to gitlab), Priya (ingest creds + prep collectors), Lina (blurb + blog outline), Jordan (coordinate legal & marketplace PM). I'll send calendar invite and 15m preflight at 08:30 PT.
Marc: pushing initial script to `gitlab.com/redwood/bench/mini-sigtest` now. README will include exact commands and how to parse CSVs.
voltops_jake: sending creds + OIDs in DM to Priya. NDA addendum draft received and passed to VoltEdge legal. we'll sign after one minor tweak.
Priya: got creds and OIDs. setting up SNMP pollers and a small prometheus scrape. :thumbsup: 
bench-bot: scheduled run created: `mini-sigtest-1777004444` — logs will be uploaded to `s3://redwood-partners/voltedge/mini-sigtest/1777004444/`.
Jordan: thanks everyone. sync Tue 08:30 PT for preflight.
Lina: noted. will have blurb + chart mock ready.
Marc: if anything changes ping the bench channel.
Jordan: closing the loop — will add a one-line footnote about measurement methodology in the marketplace copy.
